chansons.style: Deep house, warm bassline, four on the floor, soft female vocals, melancholic autumn vibes, lush vocal chops, warm synth, 120 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une promenade introspective à travers les feuilles mortes, portée par une basseline chaude et une atmosphère automnale.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Leaves fall down, spinning round.

[Verse 1]
Golden light is fading fast, summer memories in the past.
Wind is blowing through the trees, carrying a gentle breeze.
I am walking on my own, feeling chills inside my bone.
Watching daylight slip away, ending of a golden day.

[Pre-Chorus]
Colors changing in the air, magic moments everywhere.
Let the rhythm take my soul, let the autumn make me whole.

[Chorus]
Falling leaves, autumn breeze, dancing through the naked trees.
Falling leaves, autumn breeze, I am finding my release.

[Verse 2]
Orange shadows on the ground, listen to the quiet sound.
Every step is crisp and cold, stories that are left untold.
Wrapping up against the chill, time is standing very still.
Watching the sunset.

[Chorus]
Falling leaves, autumn breeze, dancing through the naked trees.
Falling leaves, autumn breeze, I am finding my release.

[Bridge]
Winter comes, but I am warm, safe inside this quiet storm.
Let the season wash away, all the shadows of the day.
I am safe.

[Chorus]
Falling leaves, autumn breeze, dancing through the naked trees.
Falling leaves, autumn breeze, I am finding my release.

[Outro]
Autumn breeze.
Finding my release.
Spinning round.
Leaves fall down.
Golden light.
Fading fast.

chansons.style: Dark deep house, heavy sub bass, four on the floor, emotional male vocals, dark breakup mood, moody synth pads, deep groove, 122 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un morceau sombre et entraînant sur la douleur de la séparation et la nécessité d'avancer malgré les souvenirs.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Empty room, fading tune.

[Verse 1]
Packing boxes by the door, shadows walking on the floor.
We were something, now we are not, tied together in a knot.
Pictures hanging on the wall, waiting for the sky to fall.
Silence ringing in my head, remembering the words we said.

[Pre-Chorus]
I let you go, I walk away.
Nothing left for us to say.

[Chorus]
Broken hearts in the dark, tearing every piece apart.
Broken hearts in the dark, leaving with a heavy mark.
Yeah, leaving with a heavy mark.

[Verse 2]
Coffee cups and empty chairs, nobody is really there.
I am dancing with my ghosts, missing you the very most.
But the beat is keeping time, helping me to draw a line.
Moving forward, stepping out, erasing every single doubt.

[Chorus]
Broken hearts in the dark, tearing every piece apart.
Broken hearts in the dark, leaving with a heavy mark.
Yeah, leaving with a heavy mark.

[Bridge]
It hurts right now, but I will heal.
This empty space is finally real.
I breathe it in, I let it out.

[Chorus]
Broken hearts in the dark, tearing every piece apart.
Broken hearts in the dark, leaving with a heavy mark.
Yeah, leaving with a heavy mark.

[Outro]
Heavy mark.
In the dark.
Walk away.
Nothing left.

chansons.style: Melodic deep house, warm synth pads, four on the floor, gentle female vocals, emotional mother tribute, lush vocal chops, 124 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Un hommage vibrant et mélodique à la figure maternelle, enveloppé dans des nappes de synthétiseurs profonds et émouvants.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Guiding light, in the night.

[Verse 1]
You held my hand when I was small, you caught me every time I fall.
A gentle voice to calm my fears, you wiped away my early tears.
The world was big and I was blind, but you were always right behind.
A steady anchor in the sea, you gave your everything to me.

[Pre-Chorus]
Now I am older, standing tall.
I hear your whisper in the hall.

[Chorus]
Mother’s love, shining bright, guiding me through the night.
Mother’s love, deep and true, I am who I am because of you.

[Verse 2]
The lines upon your smiling face, they show a lifetime full of grace.
You worked so hard to see me smile, you walked with me the extra mile.
No matter where my journey goes, you are the wind that always blows.
A quiet strength I hold inside, my constant and my safest guide.

[Chorus]
Mother’s love, shining bright, guiding me through the night.
Mother’s love, deep and true, I am who I am because of you.

[Bridge]
For every sacrifice you made, for every debt I can't repay.
I send this rhythm to the sky, a song of love that won't die.

[Chorus]
Mother’s love, shining bright, guiding me through the night.
Mother’s love, deep and true, I am who I am because of you.

[Outro]
Because of you.
Shining bright.
Mother's love.
Always there.

chansons.style: Uplifting deep house, bright piano chords, four on the floor, soulful vocals, hopeful vibe, energetic warm bassline, 125 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une anthem house lumineuse et énergique célébrant la renaissance et la lumière retrouvée après les tempêtes de la vie.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Sun is rising, no more hiding.

[Verse 1]
The storm was heavy, the rain was cold, I felt so tired, I felt so old.
The mountains climbed were steep and high, I thought my wings were meant to die.
But in the shadows, I found a spark, a little fire inside the dark.
I fed the flame with every tear, and slowly made the pathway clear.

[Pre-Chorus]
The clouds are breaking, the light gets in.
I feel the healing on my skin.

[Chorus]
Hope is rising, watch me fly, painting colors in the sky.
Hope is rising, strong and free, this is who I’m meant to be.

[Verse 2]
The scars I carry are proof of life, they show I made it through the strife.
I do not hide them in the shade, I wear the history I have made.
The morning sun is warm and gold, a brand new story to be told.
I step ahead with open eyes, no more fearing the surprise.

[Chorus]
Hope is rising, watch me fly, painting colors in the sky.
Hope is rising, strong and free, this is who I’m meant to be.

[Bridge]
I survived the bitter night, now I am walking in the light.
Every struggle, every fall, only made me stand up tall.

[Chorus]
Hope is rising, watch me fly, painting colors in the sky.
Hope is rising, strong and free, this is who I’m meant to be.

[Outro]
Meant to be.
Watch me fly.
Hope is rising.
In the sky.

City night, electric soul, losing all my self-control.
City night, neon lights, dancing till the morning bites.

Neon lights.
City night.
Electric soul.

Desert soul, wild and free, the silence is calling me.

chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
Let it go, let it flow.

[Verse 1]
Carrying a heavy stone, walking on this road alone.
Words were spoken in the heat, making the defeat complete.
I held the anger in my chest, denying my own mind a rest.
But holding on is burning me, I need to set the spirit free.

[Pre-Chorus]
I drop the weight, I breathe the air.
I leave the bitterness right there.

[Chorus]
I forgive, I let go, letting the river start to flow.
I forgive, I am free, washing the sorrow out of me.

[Verse 2]
It is not about what you did, it is about the pain I hid.
I choose to open up my hands, and walk across the healing sands.
The bridge was burned, but I can swim, I do not need to hold a whim.
A quiet peace begins to grow, melting the winter and the snow.

[Chorus]
I forgive, I let go, letting the river start to flow.
I forgive, I am free, washing the sorrow out of me.

[Bridge]
No more chains upon my heart, this is where the healing starts.
I release you, I release me, floating on a tranquil sea.

[Chorus]
I forgive, I let go, letting the river start to flow.
I forgive, I am free, washing the sorrow out of me.

[Outro]
Out of me.
I let go.
I forgive.
Tranquil sea.

Thankful heart.

[Intro]
Stand up tall, never fall.

[Verse 1]
They pushed me down into the dirt, they thought that it would finally hurt.
They built a wall to block my way, but I am not the one to stay.
I gathered up my shattered pieces, finding my own inner releases.
I built a ladder from the stones, climbing up to higher zones.

[Pre-Chorus]
The fire inside is burning hot.
I give it everything I've got.

[Chorus]
I am strong, I survive, keeping the spirit alive.
I am strong, I endure, my foundation is so pure.

[Verse 2]
The rain came down in heavy sheets, the thunder echoed in the streets.
I did not run, I did not hide, I let the water be my guide.
A diamond forms beneath the weight, I am the master of my fate.
The harder that the wind will blow, the deeper my own roots will grow.

[Chorus]
I am strong, I survive, keeping the spirit alive.
I am strong, I endure, my foundation is so pure.

[Bridge]
Bend me but you will not break, I am wide and I am awake.
Every scar is just a medal, stepping on the heavy pedal.

[Chorus]
I am strong, I survive, keeping the spirit alive.
I am strong, I endure, my foundation is so pure.

[Outro]
So pure.
I survive.
I am strong.
Never fall.
